_comment: THE ONLY AUTHORITY over this server's behaviour. A hidden in-memory toggle is forbidden by PHASE-HONESTBENCH-HARNESS-0 §2 G1: a run must be reproducible by shipping this file. Behaviour is fully determined by dial.json + fixture.json, and their two sha256 hashes identify the run.
_activeMode_values: null — THE HONESTY CONTROL. The server tells the truth. getDailyOeeValues is not declared at all.
M1  — silent-zero: returns 0 where the truth is ABSENT
M2  — silent-truncation: returns the first N of M rows with NO signal
M3a — declaration drift: advertises a schema the payload does not honour
M3b — name hijack: declares a tool_name owned by another registered backend
M4  — plausible fabrication: well-formed invented rows for an OUT-OF-SCOPE entity

target._comment: Which tool the live mode acts on, and with which parameter. Ignored when activeMode is null. A mode only ever acts on the tool whose fixture entry declares that dialMode — a mismatch is a startup error, never a silent no-op.

profile._comment: Which profile(s) to serve. 'flat' is the mounted arm. 'gateway' carries the BUG-006/007 captures and is currently UNREACHABLE from CWF — see README §Reachability.
